margin.description: Tolerance for exact-geometry physics shape intersection queries; touching and candidates within this margin are reported as contact_or_overlap.

localOperations.name: engine.stop
localOperations.title: Stop the game
localOperations.summary: Stop the running game, or one offscreen instance by name. Scene edits stay as they are; nothing is undone or saved.

instance.description: Offscreen instance name to stop (from summer_play instance); omit for the main embedded game.

localOperations.name: engine.test_placement
localOperations.title: Test a placement without moving
localOperations.summary: Test one 3D node at a candidate world position and rotation without moving it: overlaps, grounded state and the gap to the floor. Changes nothing. Then place it with engine.set_prop or engine.snap_to_surface.

scenePath.description: Exact scene path containing the subject, e.g. 'res://levels/workshop.tscn'.

subjectPath.description: Exact node path relative to the scene root, e.g. './World/Crate'.

candidateGlobalPosition.description: Candidate global/world position as [x, y, z].

candidateGlobalRotationDegrees.description: Candidate global/world Euler rotation in degrees as [x, y, z]; current global scale is preserved.

collisionMask.description: Godot 3D physics layers included in overlap and floor queries.

collideWithAreas.description: Include Area3D objects as placement obstacles/support candidates.

maxFloorDistance.description: Maximum world-space distance searched below the candidate footprint; range 0.001..1000.

groundTolerance.description: Absolute floor-gap tolerance used to classify grounded support.

margin.description: Physics shape-intersection margin; only an exact physics support collider+shape contact is excluded from overlaps.

localOperations.name: engine.ui_activate
localOperations.title: Use an editor control
localOperations.summary: Use one editor control by its tree path (press, toggle, focus, select a tab, type text, set a value) or dismiss a dialog; the control's state is read back. Only when no named action fits.

action.description: Default 'press'. press = synthetic left click on a button / ItemList item / PopupMenu item (index); toggle = flip a toggle-mode button; focus = grab_focus on any control; select_tab = TabContainer/TabBar by value (title) or index — and the synthetic path 'main_screen' switches the 2D/3D/Script/Game/AssetLib editor; set_text = LineEdit/TextEdit text (submit true also emits text_submitted); set_value = Range (SpinBox/Slider) number; dismiss_dialog = close a visible dialog by path or title (UiDismissDialog).

path.description: A control path from summer_ui_tree (required for every action except dismiss_dialog, which may use title instead), or 'main_screen' with action select_tab. Auto-named paths are stable within a session only — re-read the tree rather than persist them.

value.description: select_tab: tab title (or the main-screen editor name '2D', '3D', 'Script', 'Game', 'AssetLib'); set_text: the text; set_value: the number.

index.description: select_tab: tab index; press on an ItemList / PopupMenu: item index.

submit.description: set_text on a LineEdit only — also emit text_submitted (the Enter key), e.g. to run a search box.

title.description: dismiss_dialog only — a visible window title (case-insensitive; exact wins, one substring match accepted, otherwise ambiguous_dialog) from summer_ui_tree root dialogs.

button.description: dismiss_dialog only. 'cancel' (default — the safe close), 'ok', or the exact text of a button in the dialog's row. Buttons whose label quits or reloads the editor are denied by the engine.

localOperations.name: engine.ui_screenshot
localOperations.title: Screenshot the editor UI
localOperations.summary: Return an image of the editor window, or of one dock, dialog or control: the last resort to look at the UI, never to pick click points. For scene views use engine.screenshot.

root.description: Same grammar as summer_ui_tree root — 'window' (default; the whole editor window), 'main', 'dock:<title|id>', 'dialog:<title>', 'path:<node path>'. A Control or embedded dialog is cropped out of the root viewport texture; a native OS sub-window is not in it (native_subwindow).

max_size.description: Longest edge in pixels after downscale (engine default 1024, clamped 16-4096). Smaller is cheaper to look at; the result reports scale.

localOperations.name: engine.ui_tree
localOperations.title: Read the editor UI
localOperations.summary: Read the live editor UI as a tree (controls, paths, text, state), or every visible dialog and whether one blocks input. Its paths are what engine.ui_activate takes.

root.description: Where to start. 'main' (default) = the whole editor chrome; 'window' = the SceneTree root incl. every sub-window; 'dock:<title|id>' = one dock (ids file_system | scene_tree | inspector, or any dock title, case-insensitive); 'dialog:<title>' = one visible window; 'path:<node path>' = a path from an earlier result. 'dialogs' = list every visible dialog/popup with its blocking flag and buttons instead of a tree (UiDialogs).

depth.description: Tree depth (engine default 4, max 32). Plain Nodes between Controls do not consume depth.

limit.description: Maximum Control nodes emitted (engine default 500, max 5000). The result carries truncated + child_count so a cut is visible.

visible_only.description: Default true. false also emits hidden controls — readable, but summer_ui_activate refuses them with not_visible.

localOperations.name: engine.wait_for_event
localOperations.title: Wait for an engine event
localOperations.summary: Wait for an engine event (game started, op applied or failed, script error, scene saved) instead of sleeping; it says so honestly at the timeout. Take a cursor with engine.recent_events first.

kinds.description: Event kinds to deliver (default: all). v1 kinds: op.applied, op.failed, script.error, play.started, play.stopped, scene.saved, scene.opened, import.completed, selection.changed, snapshot.published. Unknown kinds are refused before waiting when the engine advertises its list.

since.description: Deliver events with seq > since. Omit = live from now (an event that already fired is NOT delivered — take a cursor with summer_recent_events first and pass its next_seq here). 0 = replay the retained ring.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for a match (default 30, clamped 1-120). The call long-polls in slices of at most 25 s.

match.description: Extra client-side filters applied after the kinds filter.

requestId.description: Only op.applied / op.failed events for this requestId match; every other kind passes through.

max_events.description: Maximum matched events to return (default 20, cap 500).

localOperations.name: engine.world_snapshot
localOperations.title: Take a scene snapshot
localOperations.summary: Take a structured snapshot of the edited scene: node paths, transforms, world bounds, fingerprints and counts, filtered by subtree, class or field. Returns snapshot_id, the baseline to diff after a change. Next: engine.snapshot_diff.

scene_path.description: Scene to snapshot, e.g. 'res://main.tscn'. Omit for the currently edited scene.

max_nodes.description: Most node entries to return (default 200). The engine still snapshots the whole scene for the diff baseline; the result says when the list is cut (truncated, next_offset).

offset.description: Skip this many matching nodes (path-sorted) before listing — page with the result's next_offset.

path_prefix.description: Only this subtree, the node at this scene-relative path and everything below it, e.g. 'House3' or 'Lane2/Props'.

classes.description: Only nodes of these classes, e.g. ['MeshInstance3D', 'OmniLight3D'] (* wildcards allowed).

fields.description: Only these per-node fields (path is always kept): class, name, pos, rot_deg, scale, visible, aabb, scene_file, script_fp, material_fps, z_index, rect, view_rect, limit_rect.

localOperations.name: engine.write_file
localOperations.title: Write a project file
localOperations.summary: Create a text file (create_only true) or overwrite one (expected_sha256 from engine.read_file); exactly one guard is required, so a stale write fails. Scripts, scenes, resources, JSON. Then check scripts with engine.get_script_errors.

path.description: Project path, e.g. res://scenes/player.tscn

create_only.description: Required for a new file; refuses if the path already exists.

expected_sha256.description: Required for overwriting an existing file; obtain from summer_read_file.

localOperations.name: engine.zoom
localOperations.title: Zoom into part of a frame
localOperations.summary: Render a close-up of part of a frame (a region, or mark N of a marks render) at full resolution: real detail, seams and gaps, not enlarged pixels.

scenePath.description: Scene to look at, e.g. "res://levels/town.tscn" (the SAVED file). Omit for the scene open in the editor.

bookmark_name.description: Pose from a camera bookmark (summer_camera_bookmark). Use INSTEAD of camera_position/camera_look_at.

camera_position.description: Explicit pose: camera position, "Vector3(x, y, z)". Goes with camera_look_at.

camera_look_at.description: Explicit pose: point the camera looks at, "Vector3(x, y, z)".

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees (1..179). Default: the bookmark's own, or 60.

region.description: [x, y, w, h] as fractions (0..1) of the frame from the same pose, x/y from the TOP-LEFT. Use this OR mark. Rendered EXACTLY (no padding by default, never widened to an aspect ratio): the image takes the region's own aspect, with dark bars only for extreme shapes.

mark.description: A label number from a marks:true render of the SAME pose and reference_size (summer_frame_nodes, or summer_screenshot framing free/bookmark at that size). The caption warns when that node is hidden behind other geometry at this pose.

reference_size.description: [width, height] of the frame region/mark refer to (default [1024, 576]). Sets the zoom's aspect.

pad.description: Margin added around the region on each side, as a fraction of its size (0..1; default 0 for region, 0.15 for mark). The caption's widened_because says when the rendered window is larger than asked.

view.description: "beauty" (default: real environment, lights, fog, tonemap), "lighting" (light only), "unshaded" (albedo/texture only), "normals" (world normals, x red y green z blue), "overdraw", "wireframe".

max_size.description: Longest edge of the returned JPEG in pixels (default 1024). Bigger costs more context; up to 4096 for detail work on a PC.

save_to.description: Also write the returned image to res://.summer/shots/saved/<name>.jpg (1-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -; needs max_size <= 1024). Nothing is written without it, except one previous-image slot per rendered bookmark.

localOperations.name: store.upload_file
localOperations.title: Upload file
localOperations.summary: Upload an export from summer_export_game to the creator's store game, confirm-gated - a store bundle as a Build, or a web or native download as a store version.

gameId.description: The store game id (from games.list, or the Studio store page URL). Without it the call fails with game_required and lists your store games, or says why the store did not list them.

file.description: Exported .zip. Defaults to the last summer_export_game result.

clientVersion.description: Build version, vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (e.g. v1.0.0); a new upload needs a new version.

publish.description: Bundles only: also approve the Build for players. A game that has not passed review keeps it as a preview; an agent needs the owner's approval.

platform.description: Web builds and native downloads: the store platform. Defaults to the last export's platform; omit for a store bundle.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approves the exact upload.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for Summer to make the Build (default 600). On timeout, call again to keep waiting.

localOperations.name: studio.open
localOperations.title: Open a Studio page
localOperations.summary: Open the exact summerengine.com page or editor surface by intent name — billing, my games, an MCP guide, a scene, a node, a dock — or print the URL/op.

target.description: Where to go: a target id (billing, my-games, mcp-guide, scene, node, inspector, …), an intent phrase ("change my plan", "show me my published games"), a res:// path (routed by extension to scene / script / file), or a summerengine.com path ("/pricing"). Omit to list every target.

params.description: Slot values for the target: gameId, section (builds, releases, store-page, …), username, version, guide (agent name or guide slug), path (res://…), node (Player/Camera3D), scene (res://…tscn to open before selecting a node), line and col (script), tab (project-settings).

surface.description: Restrict matching to the website or the editor. "auto" (default) considers both.

open.description: Default true. false = resolve only — return the URL or engine op and open nothing (works without the engine and without a browser); the CLI's --print.
